         重要提⽰
1.The client acknowledges that the price of securities can and does fluctuate, and that any individual security may
experience downward movements, and may under some circumstances even become valueless. The Client appreciates
therefore that there is an inherent risk that losses may be incurred rather than profit made, as a result of buying and selling
securities. That is a risk the client is prepared to accept.

客戶知悉證券價格可能及肯定會波動，⽽任何個別證券的價格皆可能下跌，在某些情況下更可能變成毫無價值。客戶瞭解在證券
買賣中固有之⾵險，即除可能獲利外，亦可能有損失。客戶願意承擔此⾵險。

2.In the event that the broker commits a default as defined in the Securities and Futures Ordinance and the client thereby
suffer a pecuniary loss, the client understands that the client’s right to claim under the compensation Fund established
under the Securities and Futures Ordinance will be restricted to the extend provided for therein.

若經紀未能履⾏「證券及期貨條例」所規定之責任，以致客戶蒙受⾦錢上之損失，客戶明⽩根據「證券及期貨條例」⽽成⽴之賠
償基⾦，客戶之索償權利僅限於該條例所規定之範圍。

3.Every transaction concluded through and recognized by The Stock Exchange of HK Ltd. is subject to transaction levy
imposed by The Stock Exchange of HK Ltd. The broker is authorized to collect the appropriate transaction levy in
accordance with the rule prescribed by The Stock Exchange of HK Ltd. from time to time. A copy of the latest rule on this
aspect is available from The Stock Exchange of HK Ltd. on payment of the prescribed charges.

投資者必須清楚所有經由⾹港聯合交易所有限公司成交及被承認之證券買賣均須按⾹港聯合交易所有限公司之規定繳納交易徵收
費，⾹港聯合交易所有限公司已授權其所有會員代為收取是項費⽤，有關之徵費規則可向⾹港聯合交易所有限公司購閱。

4.All transactions made for or on behalf of a client in Hong Kong shall be subject to the relevant provisions of the
constitution, rules, regulations, by-laws, customs and usages of The Stock Exchange of HK Ltd., the CCASS Rules and of the
laws of Hong Kong as amended from time to time, and shall be binding on both the member or Dealing Partnership and the
client.

所有替或代表⾹港客戶進⾏的交易須受到不時修訂之憲法、規定、附則、⾹港聯合交易所有限公司的慣例和⽤法、中央結算系統
規則及⾹港法例有關條⽂的限制，且對會員或證券合夥商號及客戶均有約束⼒。

5.uSmart Securities Limited (“The Company”) reserve the right to sell and/or liquidate all/or part of the client’s
securities holdings with The Company without any notice, if the negative cash balance of the client’s account is greater
than the margin value of the client’s account.

當客戶所⽋款項⾼於客戶在公司戶⼝內之可按值(Margin Value)，本公司有權在無須通知客戶之情況下出售全部或部分客戶所持有
的股票以作清還所有⽋款或債項。

6.Client assets received or held by uSmart Securities Limited or its nominee(s) outside Hong Kong are subject to the
applicable laws and regulations of the relevant overseas jurisdiction which may be different from the Securities and
Futures Ordinance (Cap.571) and the rules made thereunder. Consequently, such client assets may not enjoy the same
protection as that conferred on client assets received or held in Hong Kong.

在⾹港以外地⽅收取或持有的資產，是受到有關海外司法轄區的法律及規例所監管的。這些法律及規例與《證券及期貨條例》(第
571章)及根據該條例制訂的規則可能有所不同。因此，有關你的之資產將可能不會享有賦予在⾹港收取或持有你的資產的相同保
障。

7.Please notify our Customer Service Department at Telephone: 3018-4526 or by email: cs@usmarthk.com within 48 hours
if this statement is incorrect. Otherwise this statement will be considered as correct.

如客戶發現本結單內容有所不對，請於48⼩時內致電：3018-4526或電郵: cs@usmarthk.com 通知本公司。否則，本結單內容可
被視為正確。

8.This statement also serves as a receipt of client assets shown herein received by this Company.

本結單亦可作為本公司接受客戶資產之收據。

9.The Stamp Duty imprinted herein has been / will be paid through the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Ltd. Where the
consideration is in a foreign currency, the stamp duty paid/ to be paid will be based on the Hong Kong dollar equivalent of
the consideration at the rate of the exchange prescribed by the Stamp Duty Ordinance (Cap 117).

在此單據印上的印花稅款項，已經或將會透過⾹港聯合交易所有限公司繳付。如交易⾦額為外幣，印花稅將按交易⾦額以《印花
稅條例》（第117章）訂明的匯率折算為港幣的⾦額計算。

10.Settlement cycle of China Connect trades: Securities of the Settlement on T day and Cash of the Settlement on T+1 day.
